notes: Explanation unit is માહિતી-ખંડ (genre: mahitiprad_gadya, per explanation_unit_map.md's માહિતીપ્રદ/સાંસ્કૃતિક ગદ્ય row and 01_meta.json's own explanation_unit field). 00_chapter_normalized.md carries exactly 7 [[માહિતી-ખંડ N: ...]] markers (1-7) and 02_structure.json carries exactly 7 topics (M1.S1.T1, M1.S2.T2, M2.S3.T3, M2.S4.T4, M3.S5.T5, M3.S6.T6, M3.S6.T7) -- one topic per marker, checked against each marker's own bracketed summary text and matched to the corresponding topic_name/concept_name. No marker was merged, split into an extra topic, or dropped.

કડી/દુહો/પદ/ટેક-specific equal-count rules do not apply -- this is prose (kadi:0, duha:0, pad:0, tek_occurrences:0 in structure_inventory), correctly reflected in topic_type: CONCEPT on every topic (never STORY_TELLING), which also satisfies the profile's drop-the-frame avoid-gate cited in 02_structure.json's own notes ('re-teaching the frame as a વાર્તા'). topic_category is never 'climax' anywhere in the tree, consistent with that same gate.
The chapter is single-genre (not mixed), so the 'mixed chapter cut each part under its own unit' rule is not applicable.

Avoid-list check: no બોધ (moral) is tacked onto any objective beyond what the chapter itself states -- O7 ties પ્રસાદની વિવિધતા to 'વિવિધતામાં એકતા', but that theme is printed in the chapter's own પ્રવેશપેટી and ચર્ચા-વિચારણા box ('એક ભારત એટલે શ્રેષ્ઠ ભારત'), not invented by the plan. The cut was made by માહિતી-ખંડ throughout, never by speaker-turn -- confirmed against the normalized text, where single topics (e.g. M2.S3.T3, M2.S4.T4) span multiple speakers' lines within one fact-step rather than splitting at each speaker change.

Flagging rather than guessing at un-quoted parts of that profile.

01_meta.json records genre_confidence:'low' with a documented, still-open tension between mahitiprad_gadya and samvad_nibandh routing for this exact chapter. This check validates that the STRUCTURE obeys the ACTIVE profile (mahitiprad_gadya) correctly, which it does; it does not re-litigate A1's genre diagnosis, which A1 supported with multi-document reasoning (including samvad_nibandh.md's own near-miss table naming this exact chapter and resolving it to mahitiprad_gadya) and explicitly surfaced as low-confidence rather than silently picking. Not treated as blocking; carried forward as a note.

All 7 reading scenes (માહિતી-ખંડ 1-7, covering ગાર્ગીની સવારની વાત -> કુલકર્ણી-ચા-પ્રસંગ -> સામાન્ય સભા-શરતો -> બંગાળી જૂથ-ઉકેલ -> તૈયારી-ધ્વજવંદન-કૃતિ-રજૂઆતો -> વિનુદાદાનું સંબોધન -> પ્રસાદ-સમાપન) became topics, in the same order.

The પ્રવેશપેટી (page 72, blue box) is explicitly marked in 00_chapter_normalized.md and 01_meta.json's extraction_notes as teacher-addressed apparatus ('શિક્ષક માટે -- વાચન-દૃશ્ય નથી'), not a reading scene -- correctly excluded, no pre-reading-opener topic was needed since માહિતી-ખંડ 1 is genuinely the chapter's first reading scene.

The ચર્ચા-વિચારણા box (page 80, 'એક ભારત એટલે શ્રેષ્ઠ ભારત') is explanation_unit_map.md's own named std 6-8 સ્વાધ્યાય apparatus item, correctly excluded as a topic -- not an in-text wrap, it sits after the reading text entirely.

Cross-checked all 12 exercise_inventory entries (રૂઢિપ્રયોગ pre-block, વાતચીત, પ્રશ્નોત્તર, અર્થ-સામ્ય, વાક્ય-રૂપાંતર, ખાલી જગ્યા, ઘટનાક્રમ, નિબંધ/વાક્યલેખન, વિકલ્પ-પસંદગી, બંધબેસતો શબ્દ, સાચું-ખોટું, અનુવાદ) against all 7 topic_names -- no overlap; no સ્વાધ્યાય block was cut as a topic.
